artists.biography: Yusuf Islam, commonly known by his stage names Cat Stevens or Yusuf/Cat Stevens, is a British singer-songwriter and musician. He has sold more than 100 million records and has more than two billion streams. His musical career has explored folk, rock, pop, and, later in his career, Islamic music. Following two decades in which he performed only music which met strict religious standards, he returned to making secular music in 2006. He was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2014. He has received two honorary doctorates and awards for promoting peace as well as other humanitarian awards.

perplexity.description:
The album Greatest Hits by Cat Stevens was originally released in 1975 under the Island/A&M label. It is a compilation that captures the essence of Stevens' early to mid-1970s work, showcasing his blend of rock and folk rock styles characterized by introspective lyrics, melodic acoustic guitar, and soulful vocals. The album includes many of his most iconic songs from that period, reflecting his signature sound that combines thoughtful storytelling with accessible, melodic arrangements.

This compilation holds a significant place in Stevens' discography as it consolidates his commercial and artistic peak before his later spiritual and stylistic shifts. It serves as an accessible entry point for new listeners and a concise summary for longtime fans, highlighting his contributions to the singer-songwriter genre during the 1970s. While specific critical reception details for the original 1975 release are limited, the enduring popularity of these tracks and the album's continued reissues underscore its commercial success and lasting impact on popular music.
